A Short Note on Pencils

Pencils are good for sketches and margins. Graphite does not fade, but it smudges when pages rub together, so a pencil page in a busy notebook loses detail over a few years. A light spray of fixative helps, though most people never bother. If a sketch matters, trace the key lines in ink once it is done. That keeps the drawing readable and leaves the pencil texture underneath for anyone who looks closely.
